cases.title: M05 Attendance Ledger correctAttendance persists status change and audit row in DB transaction
preconditions: Real database transaction is enabled for M05 Attendance Ledger and M08 Audit and Compliance modules.
Closed ClassSession exists for a section assigned to the acting lecturer.
Effective policy manualEditWindow has not elapsed since session close.
Enrolled student has an existing AttendanceRecord (e.g. Absent) for the session.
Policy mandates a reason for manual corrections (VR-MC-04).
steps: Capture beforeState: AttendanceRecord status Absent, checkInMethod null or system-assigned.

As the assigned lecturer, invoke M05 correctAttendance for PATCH /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/attendance/{studentUserId} with status Manual Present and a non-empty reason inside a real DB transaction.
Commit the transaction and query attendance_records and audit_logs tables for the target student/session.
Verify M06 resolveEffectivePolicy was consulted for edit-window and reason requirements.
Assert correlation ID links mutation to audit entry.
cases.expected: M05 module boundary commits AttendanceRecord with afterState Manual Present and checkInMethod Manual; exactly one audit_logs row records actorUserId, oldStatus Absent, newStatus Manual Present, reason, and occurredAt per VR-MC-05, DI-07, DI-09, BR-22.

cases.title: SM-03 manual correction transitions Absent to Excused for enrolled student
preconditions: Closed session exists; student was auto-assigned Absent per BR-13.
Acting lecturer is assigned to the section and within manualEditWindow.
Session SM-01 state is Closed.
steps: Capture beforeState of AttendanceRecord (status Absent) and session state Closed.
Apply lecturer correction to status Excused with required reason.
Capture afterState of AttendanceRecord and verify checkInMethod Manual.
Verify prior rejected CheckInAttempt rows are not deleted.
cases.expected: beforeState Absent transitions to afterState Excused when lecturer is in scope and within edit window; session remains Closed; prior rejected CheckInAttempt rows are preserved; lastModifiedAt is updated; transition is auditable per BR-14 and BR-22.

cases.title: PATCH /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/attendance/{studentUserId} returns 200 with applied mutation envelope
preconditions: Assigned Lecturer is authenticated with bearer token and Idempotency-Key header.
Closed session exists with student AttendanceRecord status Absent from session close.
Correction is within the edit window; policy requires reason for corrections.
steps: Send PATCH /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/attendance/{studentUserId} with body { status: 'Manual Present', reason: 'Sinh vien co mat nhung loi camera tren thiet bi.' } and Idempotency-Key header.
Inspect HTTP status 200, standard { data, meta.requestId, meta.timestamp, error: null } envelope, and data reflects applied status Manual Present.
Call GET /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/attendance and locate the corrected student row.
Query GET /v1/audit-logs filtered by targetId and actionType for manual attendance update.
cases.expected: PATCH returns HTTP 200 with error null; roster row shows attendanceStatus Manual Present and checkInMethod Manual; audit query returns entry with oldStatus Absent, newStatus Manual Present, actor, reason, and timestamp per API design §4.5 and AC-13.

cases.title: Student is denied attendance correction endpoint
preconditions: A Student user is authenticated.
A valid closed session and target student AttendanceRecord exist.
Manual edit window is active.
steps: As a Student, send PATCH /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/attendance/{studentUserId} with body { status: 'Manual Present', reason: '...' }.
Inspect HTTP status code, error.code, and response envelope for leaked data.
Query AttendanceRecord and audit_logs for the student-session pair.
cases.expected: Response is HTTP 403 with error.code Forbidden; no AttendanceRecord mutation and no audit_logs row are written; no restricted roster data is disclosed (VR-MC-01, BR-19).

cases.title: Cross-scope lecturer denied correction on unassigned section
preconditions: Lecturer A is authenticated but is NOT assigned to the section that owns the target session.
Correction would otherwise be within the edit window.
Target session has enrolled student with AttendanceRecord status Absent.
steps: As Lecturer A, send PATCH /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/attendance/{studentUserId} for a section assigned to Lecturer B.
Inspect HTTP status code and error.code.
Query AttendanceRecord and audit_logs for the target student-session pair.
cases.expected: Response is HTTP 403 with error.code OutOfScope; the AttendanceRecord is unchanged and no audit mutation entry is written (VR-MC-01, BR-14 exception deny if section not assigned to lecturer).

cases.title: Lecturer correction after edit window returns 409 EditWindowExpired
preconditions: Lecturer is assigned to the section.
Closed session with Absent student exists.
Current time is past manualEditWindow from session closedAt.
steps: Send PATCH /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/attendance/{studentUserId} with status Manual Present and valid reason after the edit window has elapsed.
Inspect HTTP status 409 and error.code EditWindowExpired in response envelope.
Query AttendanceRecord via GET /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/attendance.
Query GET /v1/audit-logs for manual correction from this lecturer attempt.
cases.expected: Request is rejected with HTTP 409 and error.code EditWindowExpired per VR-MC-03 and BR-15; AttendanceRecord remains unchanged; no audit_logs mutation entry is written for the failed attempt; escalation-to-admin path remains available per BR-16.

cases.title: Correction rejected when policy-required reason is missing
preconditions: Lecturer is assigned to the section and within the edit window.
Effective policy requires a reason for manual corrections (VR-MC-04).
steps: Send PATCH /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/attendance/{studentUserId} with a valid status but an empty or omitted reason.
Inspect HTTP status and error.code in response envelope.
Query AttendanceRecord and audit_logs for the student-session pair.
Retry with valid reason as control to confirm window still active.
cases.expected: Request is rejected with HTTP 400 and error.code ReasonRequired; AttendanceRecord remains unchanged; no audit_logs mutation entry is written; control request with reason succeeds.

cases.title: Idempotent replay of correction returns applied mutation without duplicate audit
preconditions: Lecturer is assigned and within the edit window.
Closed session with Absent student exists.
Idempotency-Key header support is enabled for PATCH /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/attendance/{studentUserId} (validation §5.2).
steps: Issue PATCH correction with status Manual Present, reason, and Idempotency-Key K1; record response.
Submit two parallel PATCH corrections with the same Idempotency-Key K1, same actor, same target attendance row, and identical body.
Query AttendanceRecord and count audit_logs rows for the student-session pair.
Compare replay response to first accepted mutation summary.
cases.expected: Both responses reflect the same already-applied mutation summary; exactly one AttendanceRecord update and exactly one audit_logs entry exist per API idempotency rules §7.1 and BR-22.

cases.title: Lecturer ManualCorrectionDialog on PG-06 submits correction with reason and updates roster badge
preconditions: Lecturer is signed in on desktop PG-06 live roster (/lecturer/sessions/{sessionId}/roster) for an assigned Closed session within the edit window.
Target student row displays Absent status badge in the roster table.
Manual edit window is active; reason field is required (FRM-08).
steps: Navigate to PG-06 and locate the target Absent student row.
Open ManualCorrectionDialog (DC-08) from row action; select Manual Present in status dropdown.
Attempt to submit with the Lý do reason field empty and observe form gating.
Enter a valid reason and confirm via dialog submit.
Observe AttendanceStatusCell updates to Manual Present success variant and summary chips refresh.
cases.expected: Browser FLOW-08 completes per BR-14: save is blocked while reason is empty; after a reason is provided the row status badge updates to Manual Present and success confirmation is shown, reflecting the persisted correction and audit write.

cases.title: Lecturer roster UI surfaces EditWindowExpired escalation guidance
preconditions: Lecturer is signed in on PG-06 roster view for an assigned session whose manualEditWindow has expired.
Student row displays Absent status badge with manual correction row action visible.
steps: Open ManualCorrectionDialog on an Absent student row.
Select Manual Present, enter a valid reason, and submit.
Observe form-level FeedbackAlert with escalation guidance to request Academic Admin action per FRM-08 EditWindowExpired mapping.
Confirm roster row retains Absent danger badge and no false success state appears.
cases.expected: The UI blocks the save and displays edit-window-expired escalation guidance directing the lecturer to the admin override path, consistent with HTTP 409 EditWindowExpired backend behavior (BR-15, AC-14); roster row is not falsely updated.

cases.title: Testing-plan §3 Manual correction governance row covers lecturer scope, edit window, and audit mandate
preconditions: Testing-plan §3 Manual correction governance block applies (FR-20, FR-21, BR-14/15/16, AC-13, AC-14).
Assigned Lecturer exists for class section; effective policy defines manualEditWindow from session close.
Closed session has enrolled student with AttendanceRecord status Absent from close-time finalization (BR-13).
steps: Resolve effective policy for class section and confirm manualEditWindow is active.
Authenticate as assigned Lecturer for the session class section.
Submit PATCH /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/attendance/{studentUserId} with status Manual Present and documented reason within window.
Query AttendanceRecord and AuditLog for the student-session pair.
Advance fixture clock beyond manualEditWindow and repeat lecturer PATCH attempt.
cases.expected: Scenario-matrix maps to testing-plan Manual correction governance: in-window correction succeeds per BR-14 with full audit (actor, timestamp, old/new status, reason); post-window lecturer attempt is rejected or escalated per BR-15 and AC-14 without unauthorized mutation.

cases.title: ManualCorrectionDialog FRM-08 enforces inline reason validation and submit feedback on PG-06
preconditions: Lecturer is authenticated on PG-06 live roster (/lecturer/sessions/{sessionId}/roster) for assigned closed session.
Student row displays Absent status badge; manual edit window is active per effective policy.
Policy mandates reason for manual corrections (FRM-08, VR-MC-04).
steps: Open ManualCorrectionDialog (DC-08) from Absent student row action.
Select Manual Present in status dropdown; leave Lý do reason textarea empty and attempt submit.
Observe inline validation on reason field with aria-invalid and aria-describedby error message per FR-VAL-02.
Verify submit control remains disabled or blocked until reason is valid; confirm focus moves to first invalid field on submit.
Enter valid reason text; observe submit shows submitting/disabled state during PATCH request.
On success, verify dialog closes, post-action feedback appears, and roster row updates to Manual Present badge without stale inline errors.
cases.expected: FRM-08 form UX gates submission when reason is missing; inline ReasonRequired-style validation is visible and recoverable; submit feedback shows disabled/submitting states during request; successful in-window correction updates roster per BR-14 without silent failure.

cases.title: Alternate branch: GPS-rejected check-in resolved via lecturer manual fallback within edit window
preconditions: Open then closed session exists with GPS-required effective policy.
Student self check-in was rejected with GpsDisabled or GpsRequired (BR-08); student remains Pending then Absent after close.
Assigned Lecturer is within manualEditWindow for the closed session.
steps: Confirm student AttendanceRecord is Absent after session close with failed CheckInAttempt logged for GPS rejection.
As assigned Lecturer, submit PATCH /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/attendance/{studentUserId} with status Manual Present and documented reason.
Query AttendanceRecord and AuditLog for the student-session pair.
Verify failed GPS attempt rows are not deleted.
cases.expected: BR-14 manual fallback path resolves attendance after BR-08 self-service rejection; AttendanceRecord updates to Manual Present with checkInMethod Manual; full audit entry is written; prior failed CheckInAttempt history is preserved per BR-23.

cases.title: BR-07 exception: lecturer status change permitted when duplicate QR check-in is blocked
preconditions: Closed session with enrolled student holding successful Present AttendanceRecord from QR check-in (BR-11).
Assigned Lecturer is within manualEditWindow.
Policy allows correction to Excused with required reason.
steps: Student submits POST /v1/check-ins again for the same session and assert HTTP 409 DuplicateCheckIn per BR-07.
Verify original Present AttendanceRecord is unchanged by the duplicate attempt.
As assigned Lecturer, PATCH attendance to status Excused with documented reason.
Query AttendanceRecord and AuditLog for the student-session pair.
cases.expected: Duplicate QR check-in remains blocked per BR-07; lecturer correction per BR-14 exception updates AttendanceRecord from Present to Excused and writes AuditLog without being treated as a second QR success; subsequent QR duplicate still returns DuplicateCheckIn because a resolved record exists.
